records.behavior: A signed-in grower with zero properties stays on the AI ask home, while a direct setup-oriented garden view still redirects to the setup route.
records.fixtures: Authenticated mock session with an empty garden_properties result
steps: Render GardenApp with view=ask and zero garden properties
Assert the Ask about your garden composer and Get started handoff are visible
Assert the router does not replace the AI ask route
Render GardenApp with view=property and the same empty property result
Assert the setup view renders and the router replaces the route with /app/my-garden
success_criteria: The AI composer remains available before setup
Direct setup-oriented views retain the existing empty-property redirect
tests: website/tests/garden-app-mutations.test.tsx::keeps the AI ask home available without a property while setup views redirect

records.behavior: A grower without a saved property can submit text or photo questions and receive an answer, while answer notes and care tasks remain unavailable until setup.
records.fixtures: Authenticated mock session represented by GardenAskView props with no active property; deterministic diagnosis stub; synthetic image file
steps: Render GardenAskView with activeProperty=null and the deterministic diagnosis stub
Submit a text question and assert the answer renders
Submit an image file and assert the answer request carries image data
Assert Keep note and Add to weekly care are disabled in both answer states
Assert quickLog and addTask are not called
success_criteria: The setup handoff remains available as a secondary action
Notes and care tasks cannot be persisted without a property
tests: website/tests/garden-ask-empty-state.test.tsx::answers a text question while keeping note and care persistence disabled
website/tests/garden-ask-empty-state.test.tsx::submits a photo question before setup without calling persistence handlers
